html:
SMTO-KV-0005 — The agent tried to save a note that isn't plain text

GUID: ff911b82-4f72-42ea-92da-5ebc086b3002
Slug: kv-invalid-value
Domain: KV · Subsystem: kv

What happened

  • Notes in the Task Scratchpad can only hold plain text. The agent tried to save something else, such as raw file data or text with hidden control characters, so the note wasn't saved.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Let the agent continue; it usually saves a text summary or a file location instead. Plain text is all a note can hold, so a summary or location works.
  2. If you asked the agent to remember a file's contents, ask it to keep the file in the workspace and note only where it is. Files can hold any kind of data, but notes can only hold plain text.

What success looks like

  • The agent saves the note without this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't ask the agent to save the same content again unchanged.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Agent KV value validation rejected a value that is not a string, contains a NUL character, or cannot be encoded as UTF-8 (for example unpaired surrogates).

What this means

  • Value validation rejects non-text input, NUL characters or text that cannot encode as UTF-8. KV checks apply only to the selected conversation. Rejected validation or compare-and-set does not authorize an unconditional replacement; diagnostics do not read or mutate additional stored values.

Why this can happen

  • Value validation rejects non-text input, NUL characters or text that cannot encode as UTF-8.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect type and encoding separately from the byte-size limit.

How to fix it

  • Pass the value as a string of valid UTF-8 text without NUL characters (values over 16 KiB are reported separately as value_too_large). Store binary content in a workspace file and keep only its path or a text summary in KV.
  • Supply valid UTF-8 text without NUL characters for the conversation’s Agent KV value.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The complete intended value encodes as valid NUL-free UTF-8 text.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • KV checks apply only to the selected conversation. Rejected validation or compare-and-set does not authorize an unconditional replacement; diagnostics do not read or mutate additional stored values.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
